Z’HER0 Privacy Notice · Version 1.0

Effective 30 August 2026

Z'HER0 PRIVACY NOTICE
                                                     Version 1.0
                                            Effective Date: 30 August 2026

   This Privacy Notice explains how personal information is processed in connection with the Z'HER0
   website, accounts, formal Submission system, communications and related administration. It is
   intended to operate consistently with applicable Philippine data-protection law, including the Data
   Privacy Act of 2012, its implementing rules, and applicable issuances of the National Privacy
   Commission.

   1. Who Is Responsible for Your Personal Information
   Z'HER0 is an independent game project operated by Daryl Navora, referred to in this Notice as the
   "Creator." Where the Creator determines the purposes and means of processing personal
   information for Z'HER0, the Creator acts as the responsible Personal Information Controller to the
   extent provided by applicable law.

   Privacy inquiries and requests may be directed to support@zher0.xyz. General inquiries may be sent
   to hello@zher0.xyz.

   2. Scope of This Notice
   This Notice applies to personal information processed through Z'HER0's public website and the
   services connected with it, including account registration and administration, authentication and
   security, formal Submissions, Submission administration, submitter-to-administrator messaging,
   support requests, privacy requests, optional attribution and optional project updates, when those
   features are enabled and used.

   It does not automatically govern third-party websites or services that operate independently under
   their own privacy practices.

   3. Personal Information We May Process
   Depending on the features you use, Z'HER0 may process information you provide directly, such as
   your email address, account information, display name or username, Submission content,
   messages, support inquiries, attribution choices, update-subscription choices and other information
   you intentionally provide.

   For formal Submissions, Z'HER0 may also maintain the Submission itself together with its
   Submission or Entry ID, account reference, submission date and time, applicable Submission
   Terms version, evidence of acceptance, 18+ confirmation and related administrative records.

   The system may process authentication, security and technical information reasonably necessary to
   establish accounts, verify access, protect the service, investigate abuse, maintain security and
   establish the integrity of legally significant events.

   Authorized Z'HER0 administration may create internal review information such as tags,
   classifications, administrative notes, status information and records concerning Submissions or
   communications. Where such information relates to an identifiable individual, it may constitute
   personal information and is treated accordingly.

   Z'HER0 does not intend to require a full date of birth merely to establish the standard 18+
   Submission requirement unless a later legitimate need is established. You should not provide
   unnecessary sensitive personal information through Submissions, messages or support requests.

   4. Why Personal Information Is Processed
   Z'HER0 processes personal information only for specified and legitimate purposes and under an
   applicable lawful basis.

   Account and authentication information may be processed to create and administer an account,
   verify access, provide requested account functionality and protect the system from fraud,
   impersonation, unauthorized access and abuse.

   Submission information may be processed to receive, preserve, identify, review, administer and
   communicate about Submissions; maintain legally relevant records; establish the Submission
   Terms accepted for a particular submission; protect intellectual-property and contractual rights;
   prevent misuse; and operate the Submission program.

   Optional unfinished cloud drafts may be processed to save and synchronize a member's own
   in-progress Suggestion across devices. Local-only drafts are not intentionally uploaded to
   Z'HER0. A cloud draft is associated with the member's account, is not a formal Submission or
   Entry unless the member completes the formal submission process, and is not exposed to other
   members or through the ordinary Z'HER0 Admin Entry-management interface. Firebase/Google and
   other service providers used to operate the account service may process cloud-draft data on
   Z'HER0's behalf, subject to the provider arrangements and safeguards described in this Notice.

   Messages and support information may be processed to provide requested communications,
   respond to questions, administer accounts or Submissions, investigate problems and handle
   privacy or legal requests. Security and administrative records may be processed where reasonably
   necessary to protect Z'HER0, submitters, users, systems and legal rights.

   Some processing may be necessary for performance of or steps connected with an agreement,
   some may be required by law, and some may be based on legitimate interests where those interests
   are lawful, necessary and appropriately balanced against the rights and interests of affected
   individuals. Consent will be used where consent is the appropriate or legally required basis,
   particularly for genuinely optional activities.

   5. Submission Terms and Privacy Are Separate
   Acceptance of the Z'HER0 Submission Terms establishes the contractual and intellectual-property
   arrangements governing a formal Submission. It does not constitute blanket consent for all
   processing of personal information.

   Likewise, this Privacy Notice explains processing; merely displaying this Notice does not transform
   every processing activity into consent-based processing. Where Z'HER0 needs consent for a
   particular purpose, that consent will be requested separately and appropriately.

   6. Optional Public Attribution
   If Z'HER0 provides an option to authorize public attribution, you may separately choose whether the
   name, username, handle or other display name you provide may be publicly associated with an
   acknowledged Submission.

   Attribution permission is separate from the Submission License and from optional project updates.
   Granting attribution permission does not guarantee that attribution will be provided.

   Where applicable, you may contact Z'HER0 concerning withdrawal of optional attribution
   permission. Withdrawal will be handled subject to applicable law and any legitimate need
   concerning material already published or distributed.

   7. Optional Project Updates
   Development updates, newsletters, marketing communications and similar optional messages are
   separate from account creation and formal Submissions. Where these communications are offered
   on a consent basis, Z'HER0 will request a separate opt-in.

   You may unsubscribe using the available unsubscribe mechanism or other stated method.
   Unsubscribing does not automatically delete your account, delete a Submission or revoke a
   Submission License.

   Z'HER0 may retain limited information where reasonably necessary to honor an unsubscribe request
   and avoid sending communications you have declined.

   8. Submission Review Information
   Z'HER0 may maintain information necessary to administer and review Submissions.
   Submitter-facing Submission status is a website function and is separate from the legal license
   granted under the Submission Terms.

   Where the website displays Received, it means the Submission was successfully received. It does
   not mean the Submission was accepted, approved, selected, adopted, scheduled, implemented or
   used.

   Where the website displays Reviewed, it means an authorized Z'HER0 reviewer has completed the
   review of the Submission. It does not mean the Submission was accepted, approved, selected,
   adopted, scheduled, implemented or used.

   Authorized administrators may also use internal tags or notes for administration. Such information is
   not necessarily displayed to the submitter, but where it relates to an identifiable individual it
   remains subject to applicable privacy requirements.

   9. Messaging and Support
   Where authenticated messaging is available, communications are intended to occur between a
   registered user or submitter and authorized Z'HER0 administration. Z'HER0 does not represent this
   feature as a public user-to-user messaging system.

   Messages may be processed to answer questions, request clarification, provide information,
   administer Submissions, handle accounts, provide support and maintain appropriate administrative
   or legal records.

   Sending additional creative material through an ordinary message does not automatically make that
   material a formal Submission governed by previously accepted Submission Terms. Where
   additional material is intended to become a formal Submission, the appropriate submission or
   confirmation process must be used.

   10. Service Providers
   Z'HER0 may use third-party service providers where reasonably necessary to host, secure,
   authenticate, communicate, store or otherwise operate website and account functions.

   Before a provider is used for production processing, Z'HER0 will assess the provider's role and
   relevant terms, security, confidentiality, retention, deletion, subprocessors and other applicable
   data-protection considerations. Where required, appropriate contractual or other safeguards will be
   maintained.

   The published version of this Notice must accurately reflect the providers and processing actually in
   use. A provider that has merely been considered or tested will not be represented as an active
   production processor unless that is actually the case.

   11. International Processing
   Some service providers may process or store personal information outside the Philippines.

   International processing will not be undertaken merely because it is convenient without considering
   the applicable lawful basis, transparency requirements, provider safeguards, contractual
   arrangements, security and continuing responsibility of the Personal Information Controller.

   Where international processing occurs, the published Notice will identify the relevant processing or
   provider categories as required by applicable law.

   12. Security
   Z'HER0 will use reasonable and appropriate organizational, physical and technical safeguards
   proportionate to the nature of the personal information and risks involved.

   Depending on the implemented system, safeguards may include controlled administrative access,
   role-based permissions, secure authentication, multi-factor authentication for sensitive
   administrative access, protected credentials and secrets, encrypted transport, access controls,
   backups, recovery procedures, logging, incident-response procedures and appropriate separation of
   development and production information.

   Passwords will not intentionally be stored by Z'HER0 in plaintext or other directly readable form. No
   online system can be represented as absolutely secure, and Z'HER0 does not make such a
   guarantee.

   13. Retention
   Personal information will be retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for
   which it is processed, for another compatible lawful purpose, or where retention is permitted or
   required by applicable law. Different categories of information may require different retention
   periods.

    Unfinished cloud drafts are retained while cloud draft sync remains enabled and the draft is
    needed for the member's save/sync feature. Disabling cloud sync stops future save/sync uploads;
    a member may also delete a cloud draft or request account deletion. Z'HER0 will delete or de-identify those drafts when they are
   no longer needed, subject to limited, lawful security, backup, dispute or legal-retention needs.
   A successfully created formal Entry is a separate record and follows the retention rules for
   formal Submissions rather than the cloud-draft lifecycle.

   Account information that is no longer needed after valid account deletion should be removed,
   deleted, anonymized or otherwise appropriately handled unless a lawful reason requires some
   information to remain.

   Certain Submission-related records may need to be retained after account deletion where
   reasonably necessary to establish or administer a Submission, demonstrate the applicable Terms
   and acceptance event, protect legal rights, comply with law, resolve disputes, maintain security or
   preserve another legitimate legal record.

   Where identifiable information is no longer necessary, Z'HER0 will consider deletion, anonymization
   or pseudonymization as appropriate. The existence of a continuing Submission License does not by
   itself justify indefinite retention of every piece of personal information associated with the
   submitter.

   14. Account Deletion
   Where account deletion is available and properly requested, Z'HER0 intends to perform genuine
   account deletion rather than merely hiding the account from the user.

   Account deletion does not necessarily mean that every historical record can or must be destroyed
   immediately. Information that no longer has a lawful purpose should not be retained merely
   because the account previously existed.

   Information that remains necessary for legal, security, Submission, dispute, compliance or other
   lawful purposes may be retained only to the extent and for the duration that such purpose justifies.

   Deleting an account does not automatically unsubscribe every independently managed
   communication preference unless the applicable system does so, and unsubscribing from project
   updates is not the same as account deletion. Account deletion or a privacy request also does not
   automatically revoke intellectual-property rights validly granted through a previous Submission.

   15. Your Privacy Rights
   Subject to the Data Privacy Act, its implementing rules and other applicable law, you may have
   rights concerning your personal information, including rights to be informed about processing,
   access personal information, object to certain processing, correct inaccurate information, request
   erasure or blocking where legally available, obtain data portability where applicable, lodge a
   complaint and seek damages where provided by law.

   These rights are not necessarily absolute. Applicable law may permit or require continued
   processing in particular circumstances.

   A request will not be rejected merely because you did not use a particular form if the request
   otherwise contains sufficient information to understand and process it.

   Z'HER0 may take reasonable steps to verify that a person making a privacy request is the affected
   individual or is otherwise authorized to act for them. Verification should be proportionate to the
   request. Z'HER0 does not intend to demand government-issued identification by default where a
   less intrusive method reasonably establishes identity.

   Privacy requests may be sent to support@zher0.xyz.

   16. Internal Notes and Access Requests
   Administrative tags, internal notes and similar records are not automatically exempt from privacy
   law merely because they are internal.

   If such information relates to an identifiable person, Z'HER0 will assess it as personal information
   when responding to an applicable privacy request. Whether particular information must be provided,
   withheld, redacted or otherwise handled will depend on applicable law, the rights of other persons,
   privilege or confidentiality where legally applicable, and the circumstances of the request.

   17. Personal-Data Breaches
   Z'HER0 will maintain procedures for identifying, assessing, documenting and responding to
   personal-data security incidents.

   Where a breach meets applicable legal notification requirements, Z'HER0 will notify the National
   Privacy Commission and affected individuals within the period and manner required by applicable
   law.

   An incident that does not meet the legal threshold for notification may nevertheless be documented
   and addressed internally. Where processing is performed by a service provider, Z'HER0 will maintain
   appropriate arrangements concerning incident reporting and cooperation.

   18. Children and Formal Submissions
   The formal Z'HER0 Submission process is restricted to persons who are at least 18 years old.

   Z'HER0 does not need a complete date of birth merely to operate that standard restriction unless
   another legitimate and proportionate need is established. If Z'HER0 learns that personal information
   was collected through the formal Submission system contrary to this requirement, it may take
   appropriate action consistent with applicable law.

   19. Artificial Intelligence
   Z'HER0 does not currently represent AI-assisted Submission administration as an active production
   processing activity.

   If AI-assisted administration is introduced in the future, Z'HER0 will assess the proposed processing
   before activation, including its lawful basis, necessity and proportionality, provider arrangements,
   information disclosed to the provider, international processing, retention, provider training or
   product-improvement practices, security, human oversight and applicable data-subject rights.

   The Privacy Notice and applicable privacy assessment will be updated where necessary before
   materially different AI processing is introduced.

   Authentication credentials, passwords and multi-factor authentication secrets will not be provided to
   an AI system merely for general administrative convenience. Where AI is later used to assist
   administrative review, Z'HER0 intends to maintain appropriate human oversight rather than treating
   unrestricted automated acceptance or rejection of Submissions as authorized merely because AI
   technology is available.

   20. Changes to This Privacy Notice
   Z'HER0 may update this Privacy Notice when its processing activities, systems, providers, legal
   obligations or practices change.

   Each published version should identify its effective date and version. Material changes will be
   communicated or presented in an appropriate manner where required by applicable law.

   A revised Privacy Notice does not retroactively create consent where valid consent is legally
   required for a new processing purpose.

   21. Contact and Privacy Requests
   Z'HER0
   Operator / Personal Information Controller: Daryl Navora
   Privacy and Data-Subject Requests: support@zher0.xyz
   General Contact: hello@zher0.xyz
Privacy requests: support@zher0.xyz

About Z’HER0

Zero to Hero

ABOUT Z'HER0
Prepared: 30 August 2026

What Z'HER0 Is
Z'HER0 is an independent game project built around a simple idea: Zero to Hero. You begin without a predefined heroic identity. What you acquire, equip, choose, and learn shapes what you become.

The project is being created and operated by Daryl Navora. Z'HER0 is currently a project and brand rather than a separately incorporated company.

The Core Idea
Z'HER0 is designed around equipment-driven identity. Instead of assuming that a character's role must come from a fixed class, equipment is intended to shape statistics, moves, defensive options, tactical strengths, and the identity of a build.

The central loop is about acquiring equipment, building an identity from it, entering battles, making tactical decisions, and continuing to develop through what you choose to carry and become.

Why the Name
The name Z'HER0 reflects the project's central transformation: beginning at zero and building toward a hero. The final character is the number 0, not the letter O.

That idea is meant to exist in the game's systems, not only in its title. Power and identity are earned through the player's choices rather than assumed at the beginning.

Development
Z'HER0 is under active development. Systems, artwork, balance, equipment, presentation, platforms, release plans, and other details may evolve as the game is tested and refined.

Public material should therefore be understood as a view into an evolving project unless something is expressly identified as final or released.

Community Submissions
Z'HER0 may invite players and visitors to suggest equipment, sets, names, ideas, or other creative material through designated submission tools.

Formal Submissions are governed by the separate Z'HER0 Submission Terms and Conditions. Simply visiting the site, creating an account, contacting support, or sending an ordinary message does not automatically turn everything you say into a formal Submission.

About the Creator
Z'HER0 is created and operated by Daryl Navora. The project is being developed independently with an emphasis on building its systems deliberately, testing ideas before treating them as established, and allowing the game's identity to emerge from the interaction between equipment, combat, and player choice.

This page is intended to introduce the project and its creator. Legal and privacy information is provided separately through Z'HER0's Terms of Service, Privacy Notice, Submission Terms, and Content Policy.
